en: Vajravidāraṇī! Homage to the Blessed One, the Noble Mahāvajravidāraṇā!
Homage to the Buddha!
Thus have I heard: at one time the Blessed One was dwelling among the Vajras.
Having empowered his entire body as consisting of vajra, and with the power of the Buddha, Vajrapāṇi entered the vajra-samādhi.

Then, through the power of the Buddha, by the empowerment of all Buddhas, and by the empowerment of all Bodhisattvas, Vajrapāṇi spoke this word of the essence of vajra, which had arisen from the Great Wrathful One.

It is indestructible, indivisible, firm and stable through truth; it is unimpeded in all respects, causing the rending of all beings, the accomplishment of all beings, the cutting of all spells, the paralyzing of all spells, the destruction of all ritual acts, the rending of all ritual acts, the eradication of all planetary influences, the liberation from all planetary influences, the expulsion of all spirits, and the neutralizing of all spells and mantras.

This mantra of great power— which brings success to those who have not yet attained it, brings about the destruction even of those who have attained it, is the locus of all rites, the protector of all sentient beings, and performs pacification (*śāntika*) and nourishment (*puṣṭika*), as well as the paralyzing (*stambhana*) and deluding (*mohana*) of all sentient beings— was proclaimed by Vajrapāṇi, the Lord of Yakṣas, through the majestic power of all the Buddhas.
Homage to the Three Jewels!
Homage to Caṇḍavajrapāṇi, the great general of the yakṣa army!

Namely: *taṭa* 2, *trotaya* 2, *sphuṭa* 2, *sphoṭaya* 2, *ghuṇa* 2, *ghuṇāpaya* 2, awaken all sentient beings (*sarvasattvāni bodhaya*) 2, fully awaken (*saṃbodhaya*) 2, tremble (*trasa*) 2, cause [them] to tremble (*saṃtrāsaya*) 2, O you who awaken all Buddhas (*sarvabuddhabodhini*) 2, peak (*kūṭa*) 2, peakify (*kūṭaya*) 2, contract (*saṃkuṭaya*) 2, crush all enemies (*sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa*) 2, smash together (*saṃghaṭaya*) 2, O Vajra of all vidyās (*sarvavidyāvajra*) 2, split open (*sphoṭaya*) Vajra 2, *kaṭa*.
Vajra 2 maṭa vajra 2 pratha vajra 2 tatha sahanīlavajra suvajrāya svāhā!
Oṃ he phalini 2 gṛhṇa 2 kuru 2 mili 2 curu 2 kara 2 vajravijayāya svāhā!
Oṃ vajrakilikilmiṣa svāhā.
Oṃ kaṭa 2 maṭa 2 raṭa 2 moṭaya pramoṭanāya svāhā!
Oṃ cara cara vicara vicara husara husara māraya māraya vajravidāraṇāya svāhā!
Oṃ, cut, cut! split, split! to the great Kilikilāya, svāhā!
Oṃ, bind! bind! to Krodhavajra Kilikila, svāhā!
Oṃ culu 2 caṇḍāli kilikilāya svāhā!
Oṃ, terrify! Kilikilāya! Svāhā!
Oṃ hara 2 vajradharāya svāhā.
Oṃ, strike twice, O Vajra-shatterer, svāhā!

O Vajra of stable supernatural power, O Vajra of stable hearing, O Vajra of stable foundation, O Great Vajra, O Unobstructed Vajra, O Unfailing Vajra, come, come, O Vajra; quickly, for the sake of the Vajra, svāhā!
Aṃ dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā!
Oṃ, homage to all Buddhas!
Oṃ, Mahābala, Kaṭa, Vegatara, Acala, Maṇḍala, destroy [them] with the supreme vajra; you who are worshipped by the great force of the assembly, blaze, blaze! Ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi!
Nara daha daha, dhara dhara, vajra tejovati, tiri tiri, bandha bandha, mahābala vajra vajrāṅkuśa jvālaya svāhā!
Oṃ! Homage to the Three Jewels! Homage to Caṇḍavajrapāṇi, the great general of the yakṣa army!
Namely: Oṃ hara 2 vajra matha 2 vajra dhuru 2 vajra dhara 2 vajradharāya 2 vajraripuna vajra chinda 2 vajra bhinda 2 vajra hūṃ phaṭ.
Oṃ, homage to Caṇḍavajrapāṇi, the Great Wrathful One! Huru 2! Vajra, bind! Remove! 2! Amṛte! Hūṃ phaṭ svāhā!
The heart mantra.
Oṃ, homage to the Three Jewels.
Homage to Caṇḍavajrapāṇi! Huru 2! Tiṣṭha 2! Bandha 2! O Immortal One, hūṃ phaṭ svāhā!
Thus ends the Root Sūtra, the Heart and Sub-Heart of the Dhāraṇī named Śrī Vajravidāraṇā.
